structured_output.thesis: This is a fresh pump.fun graduate, 38 minutes old, pitching a generic AI-agent launchpad. It has heavy bundler, fresh-wallet and bot participation, the dev has already exited, and price has already pulled back about 37% from an ATH of about $110k. Buyer breadth is real, but I could not verify any organic narrative driver, and the structure looks like typical launch churn. A 2x from here before -50% is unlikely.
